Summary of requirements:
IFRS 16 introduces a single lessee accounting model and requires
a lessee to recognise assets and liabilities for all leases with a term
of more than 12 months, unless the underlying asset is of low
value. A lessee is required to recognise a right-of-use asset
representing its right to use the underlying leased asset and a
lease liability representing its obligation to make lease payments.

The Group will have a
balance sheet increase
in lease liabilities and
right-of-use assets on
adoption of IFRS 16 of
KShs 1 billion.
